title: How frequency should my child attend occupational therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Frequency of Occupational Therapy Sessions | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the recommended frequency of occupational therapy sessions for your child at Pinnacle Blooms Network - Customized plans for each child's needs.
html: The frequency of your child's occupational therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network is entirely dependent on their unique requirements, strengths, and areas of improvement. Our devoted therapists, after a thorough initial examination, assess these factors and suggest a specially tailored therapy plan to ensure the best possible outcome.
